paragraphs: Run the original ten acceptance checks and the complete three-observer save/load witnesses. These are separate fixtures; the active experiment is preserved.
Document agreement, executed checks and references to other tests have different proof scopes. Passing these checks does not certify full workbench coverage or Campaign 4 entry.

The replay supplement saves after the second observer and continues through the third. Original save and trace byte comparisons, consumer outputs and allocator-origin controls are retained in the report.

Original ten acceptance checks plus completeness and two original integration tests execute. Explicit raw imports replace repository-wide discovery with the exact three documents and two referenced test sources; source presence is bookkeeping, not test execution. The replay supplement executes all three observers, their immediate consumers and save/load after observer two; canonical save/trace equality and ordinal-free output equality retain their original domains. Renderer output is retained gate machinery, not accepted general character narration. Allocator-origin comparison tests this fixture only. Does not certify full workbench vectors, architecture participation, browser parity or Campaign4 entry. Campaign3 qualifications and18 conditional obligations unchanged.
